photos.name: 01-bulk-fold-skin
photos.summary: Mid-bulk fold in the glass bowl — taut, smooth skin pulled across the top with cheddar cubes and sliced jalapeño peeking out at the seam.

photos.name: 02-pullman-pre
photos.summary: Pullman loaf in the oiled tin, just loaded into the oven — pale dough with a melted cheese pocket already weeping through the top surface.

photos.name: 03-pullman-setup
photos.summary: Pullman loaf out of the oven, still in the tin on the stovetop — deep mahogany top with visible cheese leak spots browned into the crust.

photos.name: 04-dutch-oven-load
photos.summary: Pullman loaf turned out onto the wire rack — golden top crust with cheese-darkened patches and a dark base where it sat in the tin.

photos.name: 05-dutch-oven-load-2
photos.summary: Pullman loaf on the cooling rack in window light — burnished tan top, jalapeño peeking through one side, dark caramelized base from the tin.

photos.name: 06-mid-bake
photos.summary: Pullman loaf split open on the cutting board — open crumb with big melted cheddar pockets and bright green jalapeño specks scattered through both halves.

photos.name: 07-mid-bake-2
photos.summary: Hand holding up a single Pullman slice — translucent cheese pools and chunky jalapeño pieces visible in the open crumb, scale in the background.

photos.name: 08-dutch-oven-final
photos.summary: Dutch oven batard out at 1:18pm, internal 210°F — sharp ear lifted along the score, deep mahogany crust with flour bloom and cheese caramelized into the seam.

photos.name: 09-dutch-oven-final-2
photos.summary: Dutch oven batard from the front — open score showing green jalapeño and orange cheddar bubbling out, deep caramelization streaks running down the crust.
